scientific_integrity: All asserted finite counts were exhaustively checked with direct line enumeration and an independently organized rational-parametrization/pair-line enumeration; general BKS construction and parametrization attributed to prior authors.
scientific_limitations: Exact point and splitting-line incidence spectra only for the specified singular rational BKS quartic over finite fields of cardinality 27 and 81; no other finite extension or normalization-point-count claim. Potential unindexed earlier exact tables remain an originality risk.
title: Exact four-point splitting-line spectra of the rational BKS quartic over two small extensions
